mutations.name: carries recorded before this entry are included
kills: carry rows a carry recorded in an earlier entry is not logged again

mutations.name: no probe is treated as agreement
mutations.replace: const cause = probe ? pinCause(probe) : ({ class: "carry-agrees", exclusion2: false } as const);
kills: carry rows with no carry probe a carried MERGE is pin-differs unprobed

mutations.name: an exclusion-2 agreement reads as full-valid
kills: carry rows a carry across a clean merge-up logs carry-agrees with exclusion2
